name: Traffic-Gen
tagline: Realistic multi-source user traffic, security-efficacy tests and bandwidth/packet-loss testing for FortiGate.
description: Traffic-Gen is a Proxmox LXC with a web GUI that generates realistic user traffic (Netflix, YouTube, Facebook, Teams, Office 365, Zoom, Salesforce, OS updates, SD-WAN probes and more) from multiple source IPs and VLANs. Use it to monitor and demo FortiGate SD-WAN, Application Control and Web Filter with traffic that looks like a real network.

It also tests security efficacy: harmless EICAR/WICAR files check antivirus and IPS, while DGA, DNS-tunnelling, dynamic DNS and mining-pool lookups check botnet and DNS filtering. The dashboard reports blocked, missed and a malware detection rate. The test duration, intensity and traffic mix are all configurable in the GUI. A built-in throughput tester sends UDP, TCP and RFC 2544 streams and TCP connections-per-second tests through the firewall to a receiver on a second network, and measures bandwidth, packet loss, jitter and latency.

requirements.label: Container
requirements.value: Debian 12 unprivileged LXC, 2 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 4 GB disk by default (created by the installer)

requirements.label: Network
requirements.value: Two NICs: eth0 for management, eth1 for test traffic (VLAN-aware bridge for multiple VLANs)

requirements.label: Internet
requirements.value: Outbound access through the FortiGate under test

requirements.label: Throughput test
requirements.value: A second network/VLAN (or extra NIC) for the receiver; FortiGate policy for UDP/TCP 5201-5208

steps: Run the installer on the Proxmox host and answer the wizard (container ID, management network, traffic bridge, GUI port, admin password).
Open the web GUI on the printed URL (https://<management-ip>:8443) and sign in with the admin password.
Go to Network, add a source network (interface eth1, optional VLAN, first IP, number of IPs, FortiGate gateway) and click Apply.
Go to Traffic mix and choose which groups and apps to run. The Web filter, Malware and IOC groups are off by default.
On the Dashboard pick a duration and intensity, then click Start test.
Compare the dashboard and /var/log/trafficgen/requests.log with the FortiGate logs for application control, web filter, antivirus and botnet events.

For bandwidth and packet-loss tests open Throughput, choose the sender network, describe the receiver (interface/VLAN, IP, gateway in a different network), run Check environment and start a UDP, TCP, RFC 2544 or connections-per-second test.

screenshots.caption: Dashboard with live throughput, per-application and per-source results, and the malware detection rate.
